name: Albert Bay
life: “I still remember giving back a lunch I was too hungry to steal.” Wednesday often includes a stop at Ferris Deli, where Albert asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: I used to steal lunches here. A woman whose sandwich I took asked if I had eaten today.
appearance: Albert has a smooth side part with one rebellious curl, heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw, and a favorite piece of clothing, a sand-colored linen shirt. It usually goes with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. When somebody else has the floor, Albert turns fully toward the person speaking.
personality: Albert listens for the familiar version of a story and then for the one detail that changes it. Friends bring problems here when they want to be heard twice.
agenda: To accept a meal from the old classmate.
family: Jack Bellamy is Albert’s cousin raised in the same household. Albert sets the time to leave. Jack picks the meeting place. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *One sleeve short*, Jack says, “I thought he was embarrassed about his arm.”
connections: Bess Kaur. An unexpected offered meal leaves enough cake to take back to the watch.

reactions.situation: A classmate arrives at the reunion in uniform
reactions.response: Albert welcomes the classmate before bringing up their working clothes.

reactions.situation: Someone begins blaming the youngest worker for a missing item
reactions.response: Albert says what they know in their own name and refuses to treat a guess as something the child has to disprove.
